THE SPLIT PLATE / RECIPE

High-Protein Halal Cart Chicken Rice Bowls

Yellow rice cooked in chicken bone broth (not water) + Bare Bones broth powder = the rice does ~5g of the protein lift on its own. Adult bowl: 550 cal / 50g protein with toum + harissa. Kid tray: same chicken + rice in a compartment tray with toum drizzle on the chicken, lettuce + tomato in a side bowl. No harissa for kids — that's the only split-cook lever.

YIELD4 servings
TOTAL TIME40 min
COOK METHODSee method
EST. / SERVING~550 cal | ~50g protein
KEY TO SUCCESS: TWO PARALLEL TIMERS — rice (~20 min from boil to fluff) + chicken (~10 min on the griddle). Start the rice FIRST, then start the chicken when the rice is at the simmer stage. Both finish within 5 min of each other.

Ingredients

PROTEIN

  • 1.5 lb Trader Joe's Shawarma-Style Chicken Thighs (or 1.5 lb boneless skinless thighs + DIY marinade — see substitutionNotes)
  • Cooking spray (Chosen Foods avocado oil)

TOPPINGS SHARED

  • 1/2 head iceberg lettuce, shredded
  • 2 Roma tomatoes, diced
  • Pinch kosher salt (for tomatoes)
  • Mezete Toum sauce (on BOTH plates)

ADULT FORMAT

  • 1 big white plate per adult

Option 1

  • 1 compartment kid tray per child (4-section tray, like EZPZ Happy Mat)
  • 1 small white bowl per child (for lettuce + tomato)
  • 1 tbsp Mezete Toum (drizzle over chicken only, NOT the rice)
  • (NO Shuug harissa — adult-only)

Option 3

  • 1 compartment kid tray per child (4-section tray, like EZPZ Happy Mat)
  • 1 small white bowl per child (for lettuce + tomato)
  • 1 tbsp Mezete Toum (drizzle over chicken only, NOT the rice)
  • (NO Shuug harissa — adult-only)

YELLOW RICE

  • 1 cup uncooked basmati rice, rinsed
  • 1.5 cups Kirkland Organic Chicken Sipping Bone Broth
  • 1 tbsp ghee
  • 1 Bare Bones Instant Bone Broth Powder stick (15g, chicken)
  • 1.5 tsp kosher salt
  • 0.5 tsp garlic powder
  • 0.5 tsp onion powder
  • 0.5 tsp cumin
  • 1 tsp turmeric

ADULT SAUCES

  • 2 tbsp Mezete Toum (drizzle over chicken + rice)
  • 1 tbsp Shuug Original Harissa Hot Sauce (drizzle over chicken only)

Option 2

  • 1 compartment kid tray per child (4-section tray, like EZPZ Happy Mat)
  • 1 small white bowl per child (for lettuce + tomato)
  • 1 tbsp Mezete Toum (drizzle over chicken only, NOT the rice)
  • (NO Shuug harissa — adult-only)

Allergens: dairy, soy.

AT THE PLATE FORMAT + THE HARISSA. Same yellow rice, same griddled chicken, same iceberg + tomato. The ONLY split-cook lever is: (1) format (big plate adult vs compartment tray kid), and (2) harissa (adult only). Mezete toum drizzle is on BOTH plates. Macro split: 8 oz / 4 oz chicken portion.

Method

Shared base

  1. 1.MISE. Pull Trader Joe's shawarma chicken from fridge (let sit 10 min to take chill off). Rinse 1 cup basmati under cold water until water runs mostly clear. Measure 1.5 cups Kirkland Sipping Bone Broth, 1 tbsp ghee, spices (1.5 tsp salt / 0.5 tsp garlic powder / 0.5 tsp onion powder / 0.5 tsp cumin / 1 tsp turmeric), and the Bare Bones Instant Bone Broth stick. Set out Mezete toum + Shuug harissa.
  2. 2.START THE RICE. Rinsed basmati + 1.5 cups bone broth + ghee + Bare Bones powder + all the spices into a pot. Bring to a boil over high heat, then drop to LOWEST heat, cover with a tight lid, simmer undisturbed 15 min. NO peeking — the steam is what cooks the rice.
  3. 3.GRIDDLE THE CHICKEN. Griddle or large skillet over medium-high heat. Cooking spray. Chicken thighs in a single layer. 3-4 min undisturbed for the contact-sear, then flip. 2-3 min on second side. Chop into the pan with a spatula at the 5-min mark — halal-cart edges form on the chopped sides. Cook to 165°F internal, ~10 min total.
  4. 4.PREP THE COLD SIDE. Dice 2 Roma tomatoes ~1/4-inch. Shred 1/2 head iceberg thin. Pinch of salt on the tomatoes only. Set aside.
  5. 5.RICE FINISH. Off heat at the 15-min mark. Let rest covered 10 min (this is non-negotiable — rest is when the steam finishes setting the grains). Fluff with a fork. Should be loose, separate, yellow, fragrant.

Adult — Big Plate, Toum + Harissa

  1. 6.ADULT PLATE. ~3/4 cup yellow rice mounded on one side of the plate. ~8 oz chopped halal-cart chicken next to it. Shredded iceberg + diced Roma alongside or on top. Mezete toum drizzle over the chicken AND rice (~2 tbsp). Shuug Original Harissa drizzle over the chicken only (~1 tbsp).
  2. 7.EAT IMMEDIATELY. The contrast is the point — warm rice + crispy chopped chicken edges + cold lettuce + tomato + creamy toum + smoky harissa. Don't let it sit.

Kid — Compartment Tray, Toum Only (NO HARISSA) · Option 1

  1. 6.KID TRAY. Compartment tray. Section 1: ~1/2 cup yellow rice. Section 2: ~4 oz chopped chicken with 1 tbsp Mezete toum drizzled over. Largest section: small white bowl filled with shredded iceberg + diced Roma tomato. NO HARISSA anywhere on the tray.
  2. 7.ASSEMBLY (kid leads). Most kids eat the rice + chicken first, then graze on lettuce + tomato. Some scoop chicken into the lettuce bowl and eat it together. Either pattern works. Don't pre-mix anything.

Kid — Compartment Tray, Toum Only (NO HARISSA) · Option 2

  1. 6.Same kid tray format. Replace the yellow rice with plain white basmati (cooked 1/4 cup uncooked = ~3/4 cup cooked = ~1/2 cup per kid). Everything else identical. Toum drizzle still on the chicken.

Kid — Compartment Tray, Toum Only (NO HARISSA) · Option 3

  1. 6.Warm 1 small flour tortilla 15 sec in microwave. Spread 1 tbsp Mezete toum down the center. Add ~4 oz chopped chicken + a small spoon of yellow rice + a pinch of iceberg + a couple tomato dice. Fold the bottom up, roll the sides in. Cut diagonal. Wrap eats clean without harissa on the kid side.

SPLIT PLATE SERVING

Adult — Big Plate, Toum + Harissa: Serve the adult portion as described above.

Kid — Compartment Tray, Toum Only (NO HARISSA): Serve the kid portion as described above.

Keys to success

  • RICE: 1 cup basmati rinsed until water runs mostly clear (drains out the surface starch — fluffy not gluey). 1.5 cups Kirkland Sipping Bone Broth + 1 tbsp ghee + 1.5 tsp salt + 0.5 tsp garlic powder + 0.5 tsp onion powder + 0.5 tsp cumin + 1 tsp turmeric + 1 Bare Bones Instant Bone Broth Powder stick. Bring to boil, reduce to lowest heat, cover, 15 min undisturbed. Off heat, rest covered 10 min. Fluff with a fork.
  • CHICKEN: griddle/large skillet over medium-high. TJ shawarma chicken thighs in a single layer (don't crowd — work in 2 batches if needed). 3-4 min undisturbed for the contact-sear, then flip, 2-3 min on the second side. Chop INTO the pan with a spatula at the 5-min mark — halal-cart edges form on the chopped sides. Total ~10 min to 165°F internal.

If something fails

Yellow rice came out gluey / sticky: Either you didn't rinse the basmati enough (rinse until water runs mostly clear) or you peeked under the lid before the 15-min simmer finished. Rinse + lid-on-no-peeking. If gluey now, fluff aggressively with a fork — separates the grains.

Chicken edges aren't crispy enough for halal-cart vibe: You chopped on the griddle too early. Let the thighs sit undisturbed for 3-4 min FIRST to develop the contact sear, THEN chop. The new chopped surfaces will keep crisping while everything else holds heat.

Toum tastes way too garlicky: Mezete toum IS aggressive raw garlic — that's the authentic profile. Two fixes: (1) drizzle 1 tbsp instead of 2 per plate, OR (2) mix the toum with a tbsp of plain Greek yogurt before drizzling to mellow it.

Adult bowl macros came in higher than 550: Most likely cause: (1) used 2 lb chicken instead of 1.5 lb (4 servings × 8 oz adult / 4 oz kid = 24 oz = 1.5 lb), (2) over-portioned toum (more than 2 tbsp adds ~70 cal per extra tbsp), (3) skipped the griddle-drain step and let chicken oil soak into the rice.

Kid wouldn't touch the rice: Try plain white rice on the kid side instead of yellow. Bone broth + turmeric is a flavor lift adults like but kids sometimes reject. Cook a small separate pot of plain basmati for the kid section. The chicken + toum carry the kid plate even with plain rice.

Forgot the Bare Bones powder: Drop the protein headline to 45g (lost ~5g from the rice). Recipe still works — the powder is the macro multiplier, not a flavor requirement. Add a 1/2 tsp more turmeric or cumin to compensate for the slight loss of savory depth.

Storage and reheating

Store: Cook fresh — but rice + chicken hold well separately. Store cooked yellow rice in an airtight container 3 days; store griddled chicken in another 3-4 days. Don't pre-build the plates — iceberg wilts, tomato weeps. Assemble at meal time.

Reheat: Rice: microwave 60-90 sec covered with a 1 tbsp splash of Kirkland bone broth. Chicken: skillet over medium 2-3 min OR microwave 30-60 sec covered. Toum is room-temp from the fridge (don't reheat). Harissa is room-temp from the fridge.

Lasts: Cooked rice + chicken: 3-4 days fridge. Mezete Toum: 18 months shelf-stable, opened bottle 30 days fridge. Shuug Harissa: per bottle date, usually 30+ days opened in fridge. Iceberg + Roma: 2-3 days max. Best lunch-the-next-day recipe — pack rice + chicken + sauce in separate containers, assemble at the office.

Brands I use

Trader Joe's
Shawarma-Style Chicken Thighs (1.5 lb pack, pre-seasoned with yogurt + Middle Eastern spice marinade)
The speed unlock — pre-marinated thighs ready to griddle in 0 prep time. Marinade is genuinely good (no need to add more seasoning). Sub the DIY shawarma marinade in substitutionNotes if TJ isn't accessible.
Mezete
Toum Sauce (315g squeeze bottle — Middle Eastern garlic aioli, plant-based, shelf-stable 18 months)
The white sauce on BOTH plates. Plant-based + shelf-stable = a bottle lives in the fridge for months. Aggressive garlic — that's the authentic profile. Cross-recipe candidate with chicken sandwiches, bowls, anything that wants a garlic-mayo drizzle.
Shuug
Original Harissa Hot Sauce (9 oz bottle — roasted red pepper + chili + cumin + ghost pepper)
Adult-only heat layer. Smoky, sharp, slow-build heat. ~15 cal / 1g fat per tbsp drizzle — negligible macro impact, huge flavor impact. NEVER on kid plates.
Bare Bones
Instant Bone Broth Powder Sticks (15g packet, chicken — 45 cal / 10g protein / 0g fat per stick)
Mixed into the rice cooking liquid = ~5g protein lift per adult serving. The difference between a 45g and 50g protein headline. Free macro win that costs ~$1.50 per stick.
Kirkland Signature
Organic Chicken Sipping Bone Broth (32 fl oz carton or 8.45 fl oz pouches — 1.5 cups for the rice cook, 45 cal / 9g protein per 8 fl oz)
Replaces water entirely as the rice cooking liquid. Rice picks up savory depth that water-cooked yellow rice never gets. Cross-recipe across id 4, 24, 30, 38, 39, 41, 42, 43.
